name: @intent-wallet/reliability
description: Reliability & Self-Healing engine — the SRE brain. Turns SLIs into error-budget burn, fires multi-window burn-rate + threshold alerts, and DECIDES bounded recovery actions (failover, reroute, restart, retry, scale, circuit-break, escalate). It decides; an injected actuator acts — the engine never restarts or scales anything itself, and never loops.
